title: Slain man's brother wants Mounties to carry coffin
article: The brother of a man shot and killed by RCMP in northern Saskatchewan has asked Mounties to be pallbearers at the funeral so they can "finish the job and take him to his grave."

Walter Haineault says he has not yet received a response to his request that officers carry the coffin at Monday's funeral on the Clearwater River Dene First Nation, north of Saskatoon. His younger brother, Harry Haineault, 38, was shot on the reserve Tuesday night.
